scenes.headline: How an encoder classifies without writing a word
scenes.sub: Liquid's LFM2.5-Encoder: one forward pass, zero completion tokens.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Mochi! The usual way to classify text with an LLM is to prompt it and parse its answer. Liquid's new encoders skip all that. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: An encoder scores every label in one forward pass. Nothing is generated.
scenes.say: If the answer is a choice from a fixed set of labels, it doesn't need generating. An encoder scores every label in one forward pass.

scenes.title: Turning a decoder into an encoder
scenes.say: Each encoder starts from one of Liquid's decoders, changed in three ways.

items.say: Attention drops its causal mask, so every token sees the whole input.
The short convolutions switch to center padding, so each one reads both neighbors.
Then pretraining continues by filling in masked tokens: thirty percent of them, twice BERT's rate.

steps.say: The whole document goes through the encoder once, every token seeing every other.
Average the last hidden states, skipping padding. Then one linear layer turns that average into a score per label.

steps.note: no generate, no sampling, no parser
steps.say: A sigmoid makes each score a probability, checked against its own tuned threshold. No decode loop, nothing to parse.

left.title: Softmax
left.say: Softmax makes labels compete: the scores sum to one, so exactly one wins.

right.title: Sigmoid, per label
items: Each label is its own yes or no
Zero, one or several can pass
right.say: Sigmoid asks each label its own yes-or-no question. A ticket about a double charge can be billing and technical at once.

scenes.label: 17-task mean for the 350M encoder: 4th of 14
scenes.note: two points behind XLM-R XL, a model ten times its size
scenes.say: The larger encoder ranks fourth of fourteen on Liquid's seventeen-task suite, two points behind a model ten times its size.

scenes.text: Match the tool to the answer's shape.
scenes.say: Match the tool to the shape of the answer. A fixed label set needs a forward pass, not a decode loop.
To recap: a decoder turned bidirectional, one pooled pass, and a sigmoid per label.
